full_prompt_en: A square realist-surreal landscape painting looks past three seated people toward a distant stone tower rising from a wooded mound. The people occupy the lower foreground, seen from behind in muted green-gray coats. The figure at the left is smaller and light-haired, the central figure has darker hair, and the right figure sits slightly taller with a pale head. They sit close together on a low stone edge, quietly facing the same view. Below them, rounded tree crowns make a dense green valley. At the center, a pale old building with a narrow tiered tower and small domed top rises above the foliage. Its facade is carefully modeled with windows and vertical architectural divisions, yet the building feels isolated, almost theatrical, among the trees. A huge bank of cumulus cloud swells behind it, filling most of the upper half. Cream-gray billows catch light at the left, while the sky at the right turns nearly black. Two dark birds cross in front of the bright cloud near the upper middle. Large framing trees at both sides form dark irregular edges and make the view feel seen from a sheltered overlook. A narrow strip of distant flat countryside remains visible on the horizon behind the wooded hill. The light is strange but plausible: the tower and cloud receive a subdued glow while the foreground and side trees stay in heavy shade. Colors are controlled olive green, stone gray, and blue-black, with no saturated accent. The painting uses fine, smooth detail and deep atmospheric layering rather than loose visible brushwork. The mood is hushed and uncanny, as if the watchers are waiting for the monumental cloud to transform an ordinary vista into an event.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形写实兼超现实的风景绘画越过三名坐着的人，望向从林丘升起的远处石塔。三人背对观者，占据下方前景，穿灰绿色外套。左侧人物较矮、头发较浅；中央人物头发较深；右侧人物坐得略高，头发偏浅。他们紧挨着坐在低石边上，安静地朝同一处景色看去。下方圆团状树冠构成密集绿色谷地。中央一座浅色旧建筑带着狭窄的分层塔楼与小圆顶，从树丛上升。立面有精细塑造的窗和竖向建筑分隔，但它在林中显得孤立，近乎舞台布景。身后巨大的积云云堆膨胀，占满上半部大部分空间。左侧奶油灰云团承光，右侧天空则近乎黑色。两只深色鸟从中上部明亮云前掠过。两侧高大树木形成深色不规则边框，让视野像从遮蔽的观景点看出去。林丘后地平线上还留有一条狭窄而平坦的远方乡野。光线奇异却可信：塔与云接到一层压低的辉光，前景及两侧树木仍在浓影里。色彩限制在橄榄绿、石灰色与蓝黑色，没有饱和重音。绘画使用细密而平滑的细节与深远空气层次，而非松散可见的大笔触。氛围寂静而诡异，仿佛观景者等待纪念碑般的云把平常风光变成一件事件。
style_prompt_en: Meticulous realist painting combines believable natural detail with an improbable, quietly theatrical arrangement. Rounded foliage, stone surfaces, and distant plains are modeled in smooth fine strokes rather than obvious brush marks. Olive and gray-green ground forms sit under an immense bank of sculpted cream-gray cloud, while blue-black storm shadow creates a strong tonal counterweight. Dark trees or other irregular masses frame the sides, leaving a luminous focal form isolated in the middle distance. Atmospheric recession separates near shade, detailed center, and far horizon. Small silhouettes can establish a contemplative viewing scale without becoming the whole story. Light should feel filtered and ominous, illuminating select cloud folds and pale surfaces while letting the edges remain heavy. The result is precise, hushed, and subtly unreal through scale and weather rather than fantasy ornament.
style_prompt_zh: 细密写实绘画把可信的自然细节与略不可能、安静而富舞台感的安排结合。圆团枝叶、石质表面和远处平原用平滑细笔塑造，而非醒目大笔痕。橄榄与灰绿色地表置于巨大的奶油灰雕塑感云团下，蓝黑暴风阴影则成为强烈的明度对重。深色树木或其他不规则体块框住两侧，让发亮的焦点形体孤立在中景。大气递退区分近处暗影、细致中部和遥远地平线。细小剪影能建立沉思式观看尺度，却不独占叙事。光线应经过滤而不祥，照亮少数云褶和浅色表面，同时让边缘保持厚重。最终效果精确、寂静，并通过尺度与天气而非奇幻装饰微妙地脱离现实。
theme_en: Three seated figures watch a remote tower beneath immense storm clouds
theme_zh: 三名坐着的人注视巨大暴风云下远处的塔楼
name: Carel Willink
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
